statement.p: Let \vec F = 3\mathopen{}\left(x+y\right)\,\vec i + 3\sin\mathopen{}\left(y\right)\,\vec j. Find the line integral of \vec F around the perimeter of the rectangle with corners (3, 0), (3, 4), (-3, 4), (-3, 0), traversed in that order.

static.solution: C, so we can use Green's Theorem. The curve is traversed in the correct direction to apply Green's Theorem directly. Let R be the interior of the rectangle. Then \int_C \vec F\cdot d\vec r = \int_R\left(\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\,3\sin\mathopen{}\left(y\right) -\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\,3\mathopen{}\left(x+y\right) \right)\,dx\,dy = \int_R -3\, dx\,dy = -3(\mbox{Area of }R) = -72.
